description: Spamhaus blocklist check through Spamhaus's official Data Query Service: an IPv4 address against ZEN (SBL spam sources, CSS snowshoe, XBL exploited/botnet hosts, DROP hijacked ranges, PBL end-user ranges) or a domain against the Domain Block List (spam, phishing, malware, botnet C&C, abused legitimate domains). Returns listed yes/no, every return code with the list it means, and Spamhaus's lookup link. Point-in-time answer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
